scene_type: 2D (motion in a plane facing the camera; plane's pixel length is constant ~140 px across the frame)
pixel_convention: x to the right, y DOWN (image rows); origin top-left of the full 1920x1080 image

camera.evidence: phase correlation of rows 0-280, cols 200-1700 vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.03 px for all 50 frames (scene/scripts/camera_shift.json)
camera.view: frontal view of a classroom front wall; blackboard roughly parallel to the image plane

paper_airplane.description: small white/cream folded paper airplane seen from the side, nose pointing right (direction of travel), wider folded wing/tail part at the left (rear) end; the only moving object
paper_airplane.visible_frames: enters from the left image edge about frame 9-10 (very faint, in the bright light beam); segmented frames 11-41; full extent visible 13-36; leaves through the right image edge during frames 38-41; gone from frame 42
paper_airplane.recommended_reference_point: ref_x_px, ref_y_px (midpoint of nose and tail tips along the plane axis; = bbox centre within ~2-5 px in frames 13-36)

pixel_size.length_nose_to_tail_px: 140 +/- 3 (median of nose_tail_len_px over frames 14-35 = 2 x 70.3); a mask from blurred diff, so ~2-4 px larger than the sharp silhouette (sharp-threshold mask gave 133-140)
pixel_size.height_across_axis_px: about 10-15 px for the sharp body (thin side view), 18-30 px for the blurred mask incl. raised wing tip at the rear; bbox_h 18-45 px depending on tilt
pixel_size.size_change_over_time: none systematic (length 135-146 px in all full-view frames) -> constant depth, planar motion

paper_airplane.path_summary_px: ref point (171,610) @f11 -> (311,539) @f13 -> apex y~343 @f22-24 (x~953-1096) -> (1634,486) @f33 -> (1776,561) @f36 -> right edge ~f41 (x~1900+, y~660-680). Moves right throughout; rises until ~f23, then descends (arc). Body axis tilt (image, y down) goes from about -12 deg (nose up) at f13 to about +19 deg (nose down) at f38, fit: angle = 1.185*frame - 27.35 deg
paper_airplane.x_step_px_per_frame_approx: ~70-73 early (f13-22), ~65 at f25, ~55 at f30, ~45-49 at f33-36 (for orientation only; derive speeds yourself from the csv)

blackboard.description: large dark olive-green chalkboard in a light-orange wooden frame, centre of the front wall
blackboard.note: edges within +/-2 px; left edge washed out by light beam (measured at row 500 and visually)

wall_clock.description: round wall clock, dark thin ring with pale face, right of the blackboard top corner
wall_clock.note: frame 0 differs slightly from all later frames on the ring (render/encode artefact), no motion

teacher_desk_counter.description: long pale wooden counter/desk in front of the board, left half
teacher_desk_counter.note: bottom cut by the image, washed out by the light beam

chair_front_centre.description: orange-brown chair seen from behind (backrest), lower centre-left

chair_back_right.description: light/pale chair further back, right, near the wall

desk_far_left.description: partial desk at left image edge

desk_far_right.description: partial desk/chair at right image edge

ceiling_light_panels.description: rectangular fluorescent panels in the ceiling grid

light_beams.description: diagonal bright sun-beam bands across the left of the image (static lighting, not objects); the plane is low-contrast inside them (frames 9-14)
